## Research Questions (Reduced)

**RQ1. How does bat acoustic activity change across the season (by month)?**  
**RQ2. Which sites have the highest total activity across the study period?**

** There is a Shiny App at the bottom**

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## Load + Clean Acoustic Data (for graphs)

```{r load-clean}
acoustic <- read_csv("Data/NWTMyotisAcousticRecords_ReimerBarclay2023.csv")

acoustic_clean <- acoustic %>%
  mutate(
    night_date = mdy(night_date),
    Site = as.character(Site),
    `Site type` = as.character(`Site type`),
    `Detector Active` = as.character(`Detector Active`)
  ) %>%
  filter(`Detector Active` == "Yes") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Myotis), !is.na(night_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(night_date),
    month = month(night_date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    month = factor(as.character(month), levels = month.name)
  )
```

## Graph 1: Monthly activity by site type

```{r graph1-monthly-total, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
monthly_site <- acoustic_clean %>%
  mutate(site_label = case_when(
    Site == "SSR-1" ~ "South Slave hibernaculum",
    Site == "Walk-in Cave" ~ "Walk-in Cave hibernaculum",
    Site == "Thebacha maternity" ~ "Thebacha maternity colony",
    Site == "WBBP" ~ "Beaver pond near Walk-in Cave",
    Site == "NTBP" ~ "Beaver pond near South Slave hibernaculum",
    TRUE ~ Site
  )) %>%
  group_by(year, month, site_label) %>%
  summarise(monthly_total = sum(Myotis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(monthly_site, aes(x = month, y = monthly_total, fill = site_label)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Bat Activity by Monitoring Site",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total Myotis Files",
    fill = "Monitoring Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

## Graph 2: Ranked total activity by site

```{r graph2-ranked-site, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
site_totals <- acoustic_clean %>%
  mutate(site_label = case_when(
    Site == "SSR-1" ~ "South Slave hibernaculum",
    Site == "Walk-in Cave" ~ "Walk-in Cave hibernaculum",
    Site == "Thebacha maternity" ~ "Thebacha maternity colony",
    Site == "WBBP" ~ "Beaver pond near Walk-in Cave",
    Site == "NTBP" ~ "Beaver pond near South Slave hibernaculum",
    TRUE ~ Site
  )) %>%
  group_by(site_label, `Site type`) %>%
  summarise(total_myotis = sum(Myotis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_myotis))

ggplot(site_totals,
       aes(x = reorder(site_label, total_myotis), y = total_myotis, fill = `Site type`)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Myotis Activity by Monitoring Site",
    x = "Monitoring Site",
    y = "Total Myotis Files",
    fill = "Site Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Shiny App (kept exactly the same)

```{r shiny-app, eval=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(bslib)

acoustic <- read_csv("Data/NWTMyotisAcousticRecords_ReimerBarclay2023.csv")

acoustic_clean <- acoustic %>%
  mutate(
    night_date = mdy(night_date),
    Site = as.character(Site),
    `Site type` = as.character(`Site type`),
    `Detector Active` = as.character(`Detector Active`)
  ) %>%
  filter(`Detector Active` == "Yes") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Myotis), !is.na(night_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(night_date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    month = factor(as.character(month), levels = month.name),
    year = year(night_date)
  )

# Site metadata (helps explain site codes like NTBP and SSR-1)
site_meta <- acoustic_clean %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    Lat = first(Lat),
    Lon = first(Lon),
    `Site type` = first(`Site type`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ui <- page_navbar(
  title = "🦇 Little Brown Bat Acoustic Activity Explorer",
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    bootswatch = "flatly",
    primary = "#2C3E50",
    secondary = "#18BC9C",
    base_font = font_google("Inter")
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "📊 Dashboard",

    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        width = 320,
        h4("🔎 Filter the Data"),
        p("Choose a site and year to explore changes in little brown bat activity."),

        selectInput("site", "📍 Select Site", choices = NULL),
        htmlOutput("site_type_display"),
        selectInput("year", "📅 Select Year", choices = NULL),

        hr(),
        p(
          strong("About this app: "),
          "This app visualizes nightly and monthly little brown bat acoustic detections."
        ),

        hr(),
        h4("📘 Key terms (quick glossary)"),
        tags$ul(
          tags$li(tags$strong("Site: "), "a short code for one detector location (example codes: NTBP, SSR-1)."),
          tags$li(tags$strong("Site type: "), "the habitat category for a site."),
          tags$li(tags$strong("Detector Active: "), "whether the detector was running that night (we keep only 'Yes')."),
          tags$li(tags$strong("Myotis files: "), "how many bat-call files were recorded (higher = more acoustic activity)."),
          tags$li(tags$strong("Night date: "), "the date the detector recorded bat calls.")
        ),
        p("Below is a small lookup for site codes (if those codes exist in your data):"),
        tableOutput("site_code_lookup"),
        br(),
        p(strong("Selected site details:")),
        tableOutput("selected_site_info")
      ),

      page_fillable(
        layout_column_wrap(
          width = 1/3,

          value_box(
            title = "Total Records",
            value = textOutput("n_records"),
            theme = "primary"
          ),

          value_box(
            title = "Total Myotis Files",
            value = textOutput("total_myotis"),
            theme = "success"
          ),

          value_box(
            title = "Number of Sites",
            value = textOutput("n_sites"),
            theme = "warning"
          )
        ),

        br(),

        layout_column_wrap(
          width = 1/2,

          card(
            card_header("📈 Nightly Activity Over Time"),
            card_body(
              plotOutput("time_plot", height = "420px")
            )
          ),

          card(
            card_header("📅 Monthly Total Activity"),
            card_body(
              plotOutput("month_plot", height = "420px")
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  observe({
    updateSelectInput(
      session, "site",
      choices = c("All", sort(unique(acoustic_clean$Site))),
      selected = "All"
    )
  })

  observe({
    df <- acoustic_clean

    if (!is.null(input$site) && input$site != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Site == input$site)
    }

    available_years <- sort(unique(df$year))

    updateSelectInput(
      session, "year",
      choices = c("All", available_years),
      selected = "All"
    )
  })

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- acoustic_clean

    if (!is.null(input$site) && input$site != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Site == input$site)
    }

    if (!is.null(input$year) && input$year != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(year == as.numeric(input$year))
    }

    df
  })

  output$site_type_display <- renderUI({
    if (is.null(input$site) || input$site == "All") {
      HTML("<b>🌲 Site Type:</b> All site types")
    } else {
      selected_type <- acoustic_clean %>%
        filter(Site == input$site) %>%
        pull(`Site type`) %>%
        unique()

      HTML(paste0("<b>🌲 Site Type:</b> ", paste(selected_type, collapse = ", ")))
    }
  })

  output$n_records <- renderText({
    nrow(filtered_data())
  })

  output$total_myotis <- renderText({
    sum(filtered_data()$Myotis, na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  output$n_sites <- renderText({
    length(unique(filtered_data()$Site))
  })

  # Lookup for specific site codes (NTBP, SSR-1) if present; otherwise show first few
  output$site_code_lookup <- renderTable({
    lookup <- site_meta %>% filter(Site %in% c("NTBP", "SSR-1"))
    if (nrow(lookup) == 0) {
      lookup <- site_meta %>% slice_head(n = 5)
    }
    lookup
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "s")

  # Show metadata for the currently selected site
  output$selected_site_info <- renderTable({
    if (is.null(input$site) || input$site == "All") return(NULL)
    site_meta %>% filter(Site == input$site)
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "s")

  output$time_plot <- renderPlot({
    validate(
      need(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0, "No matching data for this filter combination.")
    )

    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = night_date, y = Myotis, color = Site, group = Site)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
      labs(
        title = "Nightly Myotis Activity",
        subtitle = "Bat detections across selected dates",
        x = "Date",
        y = "Myotis Files",
        color = "Site"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  })

  output$month_plot <- renderPlot({
    validate(
      need(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0, "No matching data for this filter combination.")
    )

    month_df <- filtered_data() %>%
      group_by(month, `Site type`) %>%
      summarise(total_myotis = sum(Myotis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    ggplot(month_df, aes(x = month, y = total_myotis, fill = `Site type`)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9) +
      labs(
        title = "Monthly Total Activity",
        subtitle = "Comparing total detections by habitat type",
        x = "Month",
        y = "Total Myotis Files",
        fill = "Site Type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
